W7 IS EITHER CATALOGUE A SUBSET OF THE OTHER?
W7 PASS -- neither contains the other (5,058 and 764 exclusive). Both catalogues are incomplete and NO denominator is available from either of them
The true number of reactions a human cell performs is not in any database, and this
loop does not produce it. Rhea is curation, so the missing set below is a LOWER
bound of unknown tightness -- reactions absent from both catalogues are invisible to
this design and are not counted anywhere in it.
The Rhea join is by reaction identity, so a reaction Human-GEM contains under
different chemistry but no Rhea id counts as missing here. That biases W5 DOWN.
Only 1,774 of 12,931 Human-GEM reactions carry a Rhea id at all, so W5 and W7 speak
about the Rhea-annotated slice, not about the whole model.
Nothing here says the missing reactions matter: an absent reaction may be rare,
tissue-specific, or irrelevant to any question this project asks.
